title: Web reader
about: Reads a public web page and hands the model its main text, in pieces when it is long.

env.TW_WEB_TIMEOUT_MS: How long it waits for a page, in milliseconds (1000 to 120000). Without it: 20000.
env.TW_WEB_MAX_BYTES: The largest page it reads, in bytes (65536 to 52428800). Without it: 5242880 (5 MB).
env.TW_WEB_IGNORE_ROBOTS: 1: do not honour a site's robots.txt. Your responsibility.
env.TW_WEB_ALLOW_PRIVATE: 1: allow addresses on this machine and its network (localhost, 192.168.x.x). Then a page address can reach anything this machine can.
